description:
The open connector SDK behind the AssetCard model (ENTERPRISE §6,
    COMPETITIVE §7 boundary: the SPI and protocol stay Apache 2 so anyone can
    build a connector; the finished enterprise connectors and the console are
    the commercial layer). An AssetProvider enumerates and answers for assets;
    the ConnectorRuntime publishes leased AssetCards and serves the
    aspace:cap/data-query protocol through the space; the DataQueryClient gives
    agents pull-once semantics through canonical query hashing.
